title: Package holidays
paragraphs: I'm sure most of us enjoy going on holiday. It's a break from the routine and a chance to jet off somewhere with friends or family. This might involve sightseeing and soaking up local culture in a new destination, or it could be kicking back and lazing by a pool or on a beach. But, whatever we choose, the most convenient way to do it is on a package holiday.

This type of vacation combines the flight, accommodation, transfers and sometimes the services of a rep, all into one booking. They were traditionally sold by travel agents on the high street, but as a few big-brand names closed, many are now purchased on websites. Travel journalist Simon Calder explains that the benefits of a proper package holiday are that "by booking flights and accommodation in a single transaction from a tour operator, you transfer all the risk to the company." This means it has to sort things out when things go wrong, and if the operator goes bust, you can get a refund.

This protection can give you peace of mind, but there are other benefits too. A package holiday can also be great value. A tour company can book airplane seats and hotel rooms in bulk which means that they can negotiate better discounts for its holidaymakers. There are often deals on food and drink too, with some companies offering all-inclusive packages – although, this can discourage someone from eating outside the hotel and sampling local cuisine and helping the local economy.

But with no-frills airlines offering cheap flights and websites offering cheap hotel accommodation, some of us have been tempted to be independent travellers or backpackers. While that might suit some, the package holiday offering has evolved, and, in the UK, for example, travel experts say the package holiday is growing in popularity, particularly among younger travellers. The Association of British Travel Agents told the BBC "there is a greater emphasis on personalisation, where holidaymakers can mix and match what they want to include instead of purchasing a pre-defined package." The only problem is deciding where to go!

vocabulary.entry: **jet off** /ˌdʒet ˈɒf/ phr. v. 乘飞机旅行（口语）
vocabulary.example: They're jetting off to Thailand for a two-week holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 他们正要飞往泰国度两周假。

vocabulary.example: We did a lot of sightseeing in Paris.
vocabulary.translation: 我们在巴黎观光了很多地方。

vocabulary.entry: **soak up** /ˈsəʊk ʌp/ phr. v. 沉浸于，吸收
vocabulary.example: We spent our first day just soaking up the atmosphere of the city.
vocabulary.translation: 我们第一天就是沉浸在这座城市的氛围中。

vocabulary.example: Thailand is a popular tourist destination.
vocabulary.translation: 泰国是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。

vocabulary.entry: **kick back** /ˌkɪk ˈbæk/ phr. v. 放松，休息（口语）
vocabulary.example: After a long week, I just want to kick back and watch a movie.
vocabulary.translation: 经过漫长的一周，我只想放松一下看个电影。

vocabulary.example: We spent the afternoon lazing on the beach.
vocabulary.translation: 我们整个下午都在海滩上懒洋洋地待着。

vocabulary.entry: **package holiday** /ˈpækɪdʒ ˈhɒlədeɪ/ n. 套餐度假，包价旅游
vocabulary.example: We booked a package holiday to Spain.
vocabulary.translation: 我们预订了去西班牙的套餐度假。

vocabulary.example: The package includes airport transfers.
vocabulary.translation: 这个套餐包括机场接送服务。

vocabulary.entry: **rep** /rep/ n. （公司派驻的）代表（口语，为representative缩写）
vocabulary.example: The resort's rep organized some great excursions.
vocabulary.translation: 度假村的代表组织了一些很棒的短途旅行。

vocabulary.example: I made a booking for a double room for three nights.
vocabulary.translation: 我预订了一个三晚的双人房。

vocabulary.entry: **travel agent** /ˈtrævl eɪdʒənt/ n. 旅行社，旅行代理人
vocabulary.example: We booked our flights through a local travel agent.
vocabulary.translation: 我们通过当地一家旅行社预订了机票。

vocabulary.entry: **high street** /ˈhaɪ striːt/ n. （尤指英国）商业街，大街
vocabulary.example: There are many well-known shops on the high street.
vocabulary.translation: 这条商业街上有很多知名商店。

vocabulary.example: The bank charges a fee for each transaction.
vocabulary.translation: 银行对每笔交易都收取费用。

vocabulary.entry: **tour operator** /ˈtʊər ˌɒpəreɪtə(r)/ n. 旅游运营商
vocabulary.example: The tour operator arranged all our accommodation and transport.
vocabulary.translation: 旅游运营商安排了我们的所有住宿和交通。

vocabulary.entry: **sort out** /ˌsɔːt ˈaʊt/ phr. v. 解决，处理
vocabulary.example: We need to sort out the problem with the booking.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要解决预订的问题。

vocabulary.entry: **go bust** /ˌɡəʊ ˈbʌst/ phr. v. 破产（口语）
vocabulary.example: Many businesses went bust during the recession.
vocabulary.translation: 许多企业在经济衰退期间破产了。

vocabulary.example: If the goods are faulty, you are entitled to a full refund.
vocabulary.translation: 如果商品有瑕疵，你有权获得全额退款。

vocabulary.entry: **peace of mind** /ˌpiːs əv ˈmaɪnd/ n. 安心，内心平静
vocabulary.example: Having insurance gives you peace of mind.
vocabulary.translation: 有了保险能让你安心。

vocabulary.entry: **in bulk** /ɪn ˈbʌlk/ phr. 大批量地，大量地
vocabulary.example: Buying in bulk can save you money.
vocabulary.translation: 批量购买可以省钱。

vocabulary.example: Students get a 10% discount on all books.
vocabulary.translation: 学生购买所有书籍可享受10%的折扣。

vocabulary.example: The island is very popular with British holidaymakers.
vocabulary.translation: 这个岛很受英国度假者的欢迎。

vocabulary.example: We booked an all-inclusive resort so we didn't have to worry about meal costs.
vocabulary.translation: 我们预订了一价全包的度假村，所以不用担心餐费。

vocabulary.example: The bad weather discouraged people from going out.
vocabulary.translation: 恶劣的天气阻止了人们外出。

vocabulary.example: You'll have a chance to sample the local cuisine.
vocabulary.translation: 你将有机会品尝当地美食。

vocabulary.example: French cuisine is famous all over the world.
vocabulary.translation: 法国菜闻名世界。

vocabulary.entry: **no-frills** /ˌnəʊ ˈfrɪlz/ adj. 无装饰的，经济型的
vocabulary.example: We flew on a no-frills airline to save money.
vocabulary.translation: 我们乘坐廉价航空以省钱。

vocabulary.example: The offer of a free gift tempted people into the store.
vocabulary.translation: 免费赠品的优惠吸引人们进店。

vocabulary.example: The hostel is popular with young backpackers.
vocabulary.translation: 这家青年旅舍很受年轻背包客的欢迎。

vocabulary.example: The company has evolved from a small family business.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司是从一个小型家族企业演变而来的。

vocabulary.example: The sport has gained in popularity in recent years.
vocabulary.translation: 这项运动近年来越来越受欢迎。

vocabulary.example: The website offers a high degree of personalisation.
vocabulary.translation: 这个网站提供高度个性化服务。

vocabulary.entry: **mix and match** /ˌmɪks ən ˈmætʃ/ phr. 混合搭配
vocabulary.example: You can mix and match different tops and skirts to create your own style.
vocabulary.translation: 你可以混合搭配不同的上衣和裙子来创造自己的风格。

vocabulary.example: The software comes with pre-defined templates.
vocabulary.translation: 这个软件带有预先定义的模板。

sentences.english: But, whatever we choose, the most convenient way to do it is on a package holiday.
sentences.chinese: 但是，无论我们选择什么，最方便的方式就是参加全包旅游。

sentences.chinese: 这种度假方式将航班、住宿、交通接送，有时还包括驻点代表的服务，整合到一个预约中。

sentences.english: They were traditionally sold by travel agents on the high street, but as a few big-brand names closed, many are now purchased on websites.

sentences.chinese: 旅游记者西蒙·卡尔德解释说，一个真正的套餐度假的好处在于，"通过向旅游运营商一次性预订航班和住宿，你将所有风险转移给了公司。"

sentences.chinese: 全包旅游还可能非常划算。

sentences.chinese: 旅游公司可以批量预订机票和酒店房间，这意味着他们可以为度假者争取到更好的折扣。

sentences.chinese: 但随着廉价航空公司提供便宜机票，网站提供廉价酒店住宿，我们中的一些人被吸引成为独立旅行者或背包客。

sentences.chinese: 虽然这可能适合一些人，但套餐度假的产品已经演变，例如在英国，旅游专家表示全包度假越来越受欢迎，尤其是在年轻旅行者中。

sentences.english: The Association of British Travel Agents told the BBC "there is a greater emphasis on personalisation, where holidaymakers can mix and match what they want to include instead of purchasing a pre-defined package."
sentences.chinese: 英国旅行社协会告诉BBC，"现在更加注重个性化，度假者可以混搭他们想要包含的项目，而不是购买预先定义的套餐。"

sentences.english: The only problem is deciding where to go!
sentences.chinese: 唯一的问题就是决定去哪里！
